notablePrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another creature.
If the creature was a Tentacle, The Watcher's second ability triggers, putting a stun counter on a nonland permanent and untapping target Kraken.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to draw a card due to Eligeth.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Repeat.
